list.title: Expense Reports
list.description: Employee expense reports — draft → approval → posted against the employee payable.
list.emptyDescription: Enter the first expense report to start the reimbursement workflow.

drawer.deleteDraftBody: This permanently deletes the draft expense report. This cannot be undone.
drawer.deletePostedBody: This permanently deletes the expense report and removes its ledger impact. This cannot be undone.
drawer.recallBodyPending: Editing cancels the pending approval request and returns the report to draft. The approval history is kept.
drawer.recallBodyApproved: Editing reopens this approved report as a draft. The approval history is kept.
drawer.splits: Reimbursable {oop} · Company card {card} · Owed by employee {personal}

toasts.draftFailed: Could not create a draft expense report

dashboard.title: Expenses
dashboard.description: Expense-report control center — the approval pipeline, spend by employee and category, and how expense spend is trending.

receipts.dropHint: Drop receipt photos or PDFs here
receipts.formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG or TIFF, up to 20 MB each
receipts.notConfigured: Receipt scanning uses the document capture provider, which is disabled or not configured.
receipts.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to enable document capture under Platform → AI.
receipts.notDraft: Receipts can be scanned onto draft reports you can edit.
receipts.discardBody: It will no longer draft a line or count as a duplicate. The file stays in the report's attachments, where you can remove it.
receipts.pending: Added to the report lines. Save the report to confirm this receipt.

suggested.employee_history: Suggested from this employee's last receipt here: {account}
suggested.organization_history: Suggested from this merchant's last receipt: {account}

receipts.requiredHint: Fill the highlighted fields and choose an account to add this receipt.
receipts.noPreview: No preview for this file type.

issues.requiredField: {field} was not read from the receipt. Enter it.
issues.lowConfidence: {field} was read with low confidence. Confirm it.
issues.invalidDate: The date "{value}" could not be read as one calendar date. Enter the transaction date.
issues.futureDate: The receipt date {value} is later than today.
issues.totalMismatch: Subtotal, tax and tip add up to {expected}, but the total reads {actual}.
issues.taxDetailMismatch: The tax lines add up to {expected}, but the total tax reads {actual}.
issues.itemsMismatch: The items add up to {expected}, but the subtotal reads {actual}.
issues.nonPositiveTotal: The total {value} is not a positive amount.
issues.currencyUnread: The receipt does not state a currency. Confirm the amount is in {currency}.
issues.currencyConflict: The receipt amounts show different currencies ({actual}). Confirm the currency charged.
issues.invalidCurrency: "{actual}" is not a valid currency code.
issues.duplicateFile: This receipt file was already scanned on {report}. Discard it unless this is a separate expense.
issues.duplicateReceipt: A receipt with the same merchant, date and total is already on {report}. Discard it unless this is a separate expense.
issues.foreignCurrency: This receipt is in {actual}. Its line converts into {currency} at the dated exchange rate, or at the {currency} amount your statement billed.
issues.duplicateElsewhere: A receipt like this one is already on another employee's expense report. Discard it unless this is a separate expense.

toasts.added: Line added from the receipt. Review it and save the report.

currency.taxHint: Leave blank to compute the tax in {currency} from the tax code.
currency.domestic: This line is in {currency}, the report currency.
currency.billedHint: The amount on your card or bank statement. The exchange rate is derived from it.
currency.reasonPlaceholder: For example, the bank's conversion advice for the purchase
currency.conversionPending: Enter the amount and how it converts to see the converted amount.
currency.quoteFailed: The exchange rate could not be loaded. Try again.
